# Classes
class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
    def norm2(self):
        return self.x * self.x + self.y * self.y
    def __str__(self):
        return '(' + str(self.x) + ', ' + str(self.y) + ')'
p = Point(3, 4)
print(p.norm2())
print(p)
p.x = 10
print(p)
